content.question: Why does naive whitespace tokenization fail on natural text? Give at least two examples.
content.answer: Whitespace does not reflect linguistic units: 'don't' merges a clitic with a word, 'New York' splits a single entity, hyphenated compounds like 'state-of-the-art' break apart, and languages written without spaces (e.g., Chinese) cannot be split at all without a maximum matching algorithm or statistical tokenizer.
